summary: The embedded Hacker News and smart article normalize profiles were keyed to apify/hacker-news-scraper and apify/smart-article-extractor, which no longer exist on Apify (the acts API returns 404), so no run ever matched them. They are now keyed to constructive_calm/hacker-news-scraper, whose rows carry title, url, hnUrl, text, by, createdAt and score, and to lukaskrivka/article-extractor-smart, whose rows carry title, url, text and date; neither field list changed. The Reddit profile stays on trudax/reddit-scraper, which is deprecated but still runs, and a second profile with the same mapping covers trudax/reddit-scraper-lite. Both Reddit Actors emit upvotes as upVotes, so that key now leads the engagement list.
reason: The registry keys profiles on the Actor name, so a profile keyed to a removed Actor is dead weight; keep each embedded profile keyed to an Actor that the acts API still serves, and match the field names those Actors actually emit.
